cards.q: According to the abstract, what is the key challenge for perovskite solar cell technology?
Which database is cited as the best example of accumulated perovskite stability data?
What do the authors identify as a critical question for future perovskite databases?
What did the learning curves show about adding more data of the same quality?
cards.a: The potential for improving the models' performance is limited.

cards.q: According to the study, what would significantly improve model performance?
cards.a: Increasing data quality by reporting more complete information on the performed experiments.

cards.q: What can the choice of stability metric do to the interpretation of aging experiments?
cards.a: It can strongly change the interpretation, unnaturally favoring some cells over others.

cards.q: How many perovskite solar cells with reported device stability were taken from the database?
Which machine-learning method was used to identify the most important factors for cell stability?
How many solar cells does the in-house database contain?
How does the in-house database differ from databases holding single-number stability metrics?
cards.a: The entire aging curve for each cell is available.
